package quic

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"sync"
	"testing"

	"github.com/quic-go/quic-go/internal/monotime"
	"github.com/quic-go/quic-go/internal/protocol"
	"github.com/quic-go/quic-go/internal/qerr"
	"github.com/quic-go/quic-go/internal/wire"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"go.uber.org/mock/gomock"
)

// The zero value is unlimited, including for the Config reflection fixture.
type relayQUICReceiveBudget struct {
	mu        sync.Mutex
	max, used int64
}

func (b *relayQUICReceiveBudget) TryAcquire(n int64) bool {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	if b.max > 0 && n > b.max-b.used {
		return false
	}
	b.used += n
	return true
}
func (b *relayQUICReceiveBudget) Release(n int64) {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	b.used -= n
	if b.used < 0 {
		panic("receive budget released twice")
	}
}
func (b *relayQUICReceiveBudget) bytes() int64 {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	return b.used
}

func relayBudgetReceiveStream(t *testing.T, budget *relayQUICReceiveBudget) *ReceiveStream {
	t.Helper()
	sender := NewMockStreamSender(gomock.NewController(t))
	sender.EXPECT().onStreamCompleted(gomock.Any()).AnyTimes()
	sender.EXPECT().onHasStreamControlFrame(gomock.Any(), gomock.Any()).AnyTimes()
	sender.EXPECT().onHasConnectionData().AnyTimes()
	str := newReceiveStream(42, sender, newTestStreamFlowController(42))
	str.frameQueue.receiveBufferBudget = budget
	return str
}

func TestRelayQUICReceiveBudgetPooledCapacityAndTrim(t *testing.T) {
	for _, length := range []int{8, protocol.MinStreamFrameBufferSize + 16} {
		t.Run(fmt.Sprint(length), func(t *testing.T) {
			budget := &relayQUICReceiveBudget{}
			s := newFrameSorter()
			s.receiveBufferBudget = budget
			require.NoError(t, s.Push([]byte("abc"), 0, nil))
			frame := wire.GetStreamFrame()
			frame.Data = frame.Data[:length]
			capacity := cap(frame.Data)
			returned := 0
			require.NoError(t, s.Push(frame.Data, 1, func() { returned++; frame.PutBack() }))
			_, first, done := s.Pop()
			require.Equal(t, []byte("abc"), first)
			done()
			_, data, done := s.Pop()
			require.Len(t, data, length-2)
			if len(data) < protocol.MinStreamFrameBufferSize {
				require.Equal(t, 1, returned, "trimmed small frame must release pooled backing immediately")
				require.Equal(t, int64(cap(data)+256), budget.bytes())
			} else {
				require.Zero(t, returned)
				require.Equal(t, int64(capacity+256), budget.bytes(), "leading trim retains entire pooled backing")
			}
			s.Discard() // popped bytes remain owned by the reader
			require.Positive(t, budget.bytes())
			done()
			done()
			require.Equal(t, 1, returned)
			require.Zero(t, budget.bytes())
		})
	}
}

func TestRelayQUICReceiveBudgetRejectedCopiedTrimReturnsPoolOnce(t *testing.T) {
	budget := &relayQUICReceiveBudget{max: 500}
	s := newFrameSorter()
	s.receiveBufferBudget = budget
	require.NoError(t, s.Push([]byte("abc"), 0, nil))
	frame := wire.GetStreamFrame()
	frame.Data = frame.Data[:8]
	returned := 0
	require.Error(t, s.Push(frame.Data, 1, func() { returned++; frame.PutBack() }))
	require.Equal(t, 1, returned, "small trim and rejection must not both return the same pooled frame")
	require.Equal(t, int64(259), budget.bytes())
	s.Discard()
	require.Zero(t, budget.bytes())
}

func TestRelayQUICReceiveBudgetConsumedFrameReleasedWithoutAnotherRead(t *testing.T) {
	budget := &relayQUICReceiveBudget{}
	str := relayBudgetReceiveStream(t, budget)
	require.NoError(t, str.handleStreamFrame(&wire.StreamFrame{Data: []byte("abcdef")}, monotime.Now()))
	n, err := str.Read(make([]byte, 6))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, 6, n)
	require.Zero(t, budget.bytes(), "consuming the frame must release its backing without waiting for the next Read")
	str.CancelRead(1337)
	require.Zero(t, budget.bytes())
}

func TestRelayQUICReceiveBudgetSharedExhaustionAndCleanup(t *testing.T) {
	budget := &relayQUICReceiveBudget{max: 600}
	first, second := newFrameSorter(), newFrameSorter()
	first.receiveBufferBudget, second.receiveBufferBudget = budget, budget
	firstFreed, rejectedFreed := 0, 0
	require.NoError(t, first.Push(make([]byte, 64, 256), 0, func() { firstFreed++ }))
	err := second.Push(make([]byte, 64, 256), 0, func() { rejectedFreed++ })
	var transportErr *qerr.TransportError
	require.ErrorAs(t, err, &transportErr)
	require.Equal(t, qerr.InternalError, transportErr.ErrorCode)
	require.Equal(t, 1, rejectedFreed)
	require.Equal(t, int64(512), budget.bytes())
	first.Discard()
	first.Discard()
	second.Discard()
	require.Equal(t, 1, firstFreed)
	require.Zero(t, budget.bytes())
}

func TestRelayQUICReceiveBudgetDiscardDropsMetadata(t *testing.T) {
	budget := &relayQUICReceiveBudget{}
	s := newFrameSorter()
	s.receiveBufferBudget = budget
	for i := 0; i < 200; i++ {
		require.NoError(t, s.Push([]byte{1}, protocol.ByteCount(2*i+1), nil))
	}
	require.Greater(t, s.gaps.Len(), 100)
	s.Discard()
	require.Zero(t, budget.bytes())
	require.Nil(t, s.queue, "discarded sorter must release old map allocation")
	require.Equal(t, 1, s.gaps.Len(), "discarded gap nodes must not remain reachable")
}

func TestRelayQUICReceiveBudgetFINRemainsReadableUntilDrained(t *testing.T) {
	budget := &relayQUICReceiveBudget{}
	str := relayBudgetReceiveStream(t, budget)
	require.NoError(t, str.handleStreamFrame(&wire.StreamFrame{Data: []byte("abcdef"), Fin: true}, monotime.Now()))
	charged := budget.bytes()
	require.Positive(t, charged)
	data := make([]byte, 2)
	n, err := str.Read(data)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, 2, n)
	require.Equal(t, "ab", string(data))
	require.Equal(t, charged, budget.bytes(), "partially read FIN must retain unread bytes")
	data = make([]byte, 4)
	n, err = str.Read(data)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, io.EOF)
	require.Equal(t, 4, n)
	require.Equal(t, "cdef", string(data))
	require.Zero(t, budget.bytes())
	str.CancelRead(1337) // an already-observed FIN remains EOF
	n, err = str.Read(make([]byte, 1))
	require.Zero(t, n)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, io.EOF)
}

func TestRelayQUICReceiveBudgetCancellationReleasesPartialAndQueuedData(t *testing.T) {
	for _, kind := range []string{"local", "remote", "shutdown"} {
		t.Run(kind, func(t *testing.T) {
			budget := &relayQUICReceiveBudget{}
			str := relayBudgetReceiveStream(t, budget)
			require.NoError(t, str.handleStreamFrame(&wire.StreamFrame{Data: []byte("abcdef")}, monotime.Now()))
			require.NoError(t, str.handleStreamFrame(&wire.StreamFrame{Offset: 8, Data: []byte("gh")}, monotime.Now()))
			n, err := str.Read(make([]byte, 2))
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Equal(t, 2, n)
			require.Positive(t, budget.bytes())
			var expected error
			switch kind {
			case "local":
				str.CancelRead(1337)
				expected = &StreamError{StreamID: 42, ErrorCode: 1337}
			case "remote":
				require.NoError(t, str.handleResetStreamFrame(&wire.ResetStreamFrame{StreamID: 42, FinalSize: 10, ErrorCode: 1337}, monotime.Now()))
				expected = &StreamError{StreamID: 42, ErrorCode: 1337, Remote: true}
			case "shutdown":
				expected = errors.New("connection stopped")
				str.closeForShutdown(expected)
			}
			require.Zero(t, budget.bytes())
			n, err = str.Read(make([]byte, 1))
			require.Zero(t, n)
			require.ErrorIs(t, err, expected)
			str.CancelRead(1337)
			str.closeForShutdown(expected)
			require.Zero(t, budget.bytes())
		})
	}
}

func TestRelayQUICReceiveBudgetResetPartiallyReadFINPreservesError(t *testing.T) {
	for _, reliable := range []protocol.ByteCount{0, 4} {
		t.Run(string(rune(reliable+'0')), func(t *testing.T) {
			budget := &relayQUICReceiveBudget{}
			str := relayBudgetReceiveStream(t, budget)
			require.NoError(t, str.handleStreamFrame(&wire.StreamFrame{Data: []byte("abcdef"), Fin: true}, monotime.Now()))
			n, err := str.Read(make([]byte, 2))
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Equal(t, 2, n)
			require.NoError(t, str.handleResetStreamFrame(&wire.ResetStreamFrame{StreamID: 42, FinalSize: 6, ReliableSize: reliable, ErrorCode: 1337}, monotime.Now()))
			remaining := max(0, int(reliable)-2)
			if remaining > 0 {
				require.Positive(t, budget.bytes())
			} else {
				require.Zero(t, budget.bytes())
			}
			n, err = str.Read(make([]byte, max(1, remaining)))
			require.Equal(t, remaining, n)
			require.ErrorIs(t, err, &StreamError{StreamID: 42, ErrorCode: 1337, Remote: true})
			require.Zero(t, budget.bytes())
			n, err = str.Read(make([]byte, 1))
			require.Zero(t, n)
			require.ErrorIs(t, err, &StreamError{StreamID: 42, ErrorCode: 1337, Remote: true})
		})
	}
}

func TestRelayQUICReceiveBudgetAttachedToEveryReceivingStreamKind(t *testing.T) {
	budget := &relayQUICReceiveBudget{}
	sender := NewMockStreamSender(gomock.NewController(t))
	m := newStreamsMap(context.Background(), sender, func(wire.Frame) {}, newTestStreamFlowController, 10, 10, protocol.PerspectiveServer)
	m.receiveBufferBudget = budget
	m.HandleTransportParameters(&wire.TransportParameters{MaxBidiStreamNum: 10, MaxUniStreamNum: 10})
	outgoing, err := m.OpenStream()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Same(t, budget, outgoing.receiveStr.frameQueue.receiveBufferBudget)
	require.NoError(t, m.HandleStreamFrame(&wire.StreamFrame{StreamID: 0}, monotime.Now()))
	incoming, err := m.AcceptStream(context.Background())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Same(t, budget, incoming.receiveStr.frameQueue.receiveBufferBudget)
	require.NoError(t, m.HandleStreamFrame(&wire.StreamFrame{StreamID: 2}, monotime.Now()))
	uni, err := m.AcceptUniStream(context.Background())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Same(t, budget, uni.frameQueue.receiveBufferBudget)
	require.Same(t, budget, populateConfig(&Config{ReceiveBufferBudget: budget}).ReceiveBufferBudget)
}
